description_en: Modifies the status of a virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall that protects traffic between two VPCs connected through Express Connect
description_zh: 修改VPC边界防火墙（防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量）的开关状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-vpc-firewall-switch-status --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --firewall-switch open --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpcFirewallSwitchStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342932.html operation to query the instance ID of the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342932.html接口查询VPC边界防火墙的实例ID
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Valid values:

open: enabled.

close: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设置VPC边界防火墙的开关状态。取值：

open：开启。

close：关闭
parameters.name: firewall_switch

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid
